policy.roster_context: Previous seasons using exact published player IDs; stat quality holds applied; normalized within prior league-season.
policy.review: Strong review needs model and current standings agreement; outcome-only outliers are Watch; invalid standings trigger a source-data Watch with no placements.
policy.minimum_for_review: 6 matched games, three unique opponents and three connected peers in same division
policy.cross_division_comparison: Same match graph component + at least three direct bridging games + same program family
policy.masters: Never infer eligibility from team names, roster ages or source GP; Masters partitions protected
policy.source_gap: Weak GP reconciliation lowers evidence grade
policy.decision: Commissioner review draft only; zero production writes

validation.rating_quality: Rolling pre-game predictions only once both opponents have two earlier source-qualified games.
validation.outcome: Win=1, tie=0.5, loss=0; no claim of prospective league-wide calibration.

guardrails: Never move a team based on a model output without commissioner approval and rink/schedule impact review.
SVHL Rule 2.7.2: division realignment after week five; accumulated points carry over.
Game sheet signatures, Masters age exemptions and playoff eligibility require official identity checks.
Do not automatically merge same-name players across historic source-ID changes.
Do not label an unknown rink time as available ice.
No cross-night rating comparability has been established.
All roster samples are published roster entries; not verified attendance.
